p.title: One VIX band across home, regime summary and chat
p.symptom: VIX 16.34 read '주의' (green) on the home card, '안정' in the market-state summary used by briefing/chat, and a third 20/25 band in the chat fallback.
p.root_cause: Three owners hard-coded different VIX thresholds (15/20/25/30, 18/25/32, 20/25) for the same label surface.
p.fix: Home card and chat fallback use the canonical aio-core _vixBand thresholds 18/25/32 with labels 안정/보통/경계/패닉.
p.violated_rule: One metric, one interpretation per session.
p.prevention: Inline P1367 markers at both former owners point to the canonical band; browser check shows home '안정' for VIX 16.34.
p.verification: Local browser v56.88: home-vix-status '안정' at VIX 16.34, matching the regime summary.

changelog: **VIX 구간 통일 (P1367):** 홈·시장 상태 요약·채팅의 서로 다른 VIX 구간(주의/안정 혼재)을 18/25/32 단일 기준으로 통일.
